Latoya Williams.description: conversing about Latoya Williams and Sam Moore discussing their recent activities, including Latoya's photography series and Sam's mayoral campaign, and planning a meeting at Hobbs cafe to view some of Latoya's work. @ <persona> Sam Moore
chat: Latoya Williams
Hi Sam, how are you doing today?
Sam Moore
Good to see you, Latoya. I hope your run is going well today.
Latoya Williams
Yeah, it's going great. Thanks for asking! How about you? Have you been keeping busy?
Sam Moore
Always nice to catch up, Latoya. I've been quite busy with my mayoral campaign and community meetings. How about you since we last talked?
Latoya Williams
It sounds like you've been very active. My focus has mostly been on my photography series and staying informed about local politics. How do you feel things are progressing with your campaign?
Sam Moore
Things are moving along nicely, Latoya. I've been meeting lots of folks around town and discussing my vision for the community. How about your photography series? Have you got any new works to share?
Latoya Williams

Absolutely, Sam. I've been working on some pieces inspired by my recent travels and also exploring themes related to our local community through my lens. Would you like to take a look at some of them sometime?
Sam Moore
That sounds fascinating, Latoya. I'd love to see your work sometime soon. Perhaps we could arrange a coffee meeting at Hobbs cafe this week?
Latoya Williams
That would be great, Sam. Let's aim for Wednesday at 2 PM then.
Sam Moore
Sounds good to me, Latoya. Looking forward to it.
Latoya Williams
Perfect, I'll see you there Sam. Have a great day!
